name: Fireflies.ai
description_en:
Fireflies.ai records or imports conversations, transcribes them and generates searchable meeting summaries and action items. Capture routes include a meeting bot, browser extension, desktop/mobile apps and uploaded files.

Its Free and paid plans separate transcription, storage, summaries, AI credits and integration limits. An unlimited label on one dimension should not be extended to every meeting capability.
description_zh:
Fireflies.ai 录制或导入对话，生成转录、可检索会议摘要和行动项。捕捉方式包括会议机器人、浏览器扩展、桌面及移动应用和文件上传。

免费及付费套餐分别限制转录、存储、摘要、AI credits 和集成，不能把一个维度的“不限”推广到所有会议能力。

sections.title_en: Choose a capture route and inspect the evidence
sections.title_zh: 选择捕捉方式并检查证据
sections.en: The official site describes inviting fred@fireflies.ai or calendar auto-join, Google Meet extension capture, in-person mobile recording and audio/video upload. Search, AskFred, clips and topic analysis work over collected meeting records. A meeting bot still needs admission and a permitted recording context; file upload cannot recover audio that was never captured.
sections.zh: 官网介绍邀请 fred@fireflies.ai 或日历自动加入、Google Meet 扩展捕捉、移动现场录制及音视频上传。搜索、AskFred、片段和主题分析基于所收集记录。机器人仍需准入及允许录制的环境，文件上传也不能恢复从未录下的音频。

sections.title_zh: 示例：核对客户通话摘要
sections.en: Pilot a non-sensitive call, compare speaker attribution and numbers with the audio, then verify action owners before sending a recap or updating the CRM. Include a declined bot admission or interrupted recording to see what is missing. A generated summary can sound complete despite missing capture; this is a failure case to test, not a failure observed in this review.
sections.zh: 试点非敏感通话，把说话者归属和数字与音频核对，再确认行动负责人后发送摘要或更新 CRM。还应检查机器人被拒绝或录制中断时缺少什么。摘要可能在录音不完整时仍显得完整，这是建议测试的失败场景，并非本次已观察故障。

sections.title_en: Storage, summaries, AI credits and rate limits
sections.title_zh: 存储、摘要、AI credits 与调用限制
sections.en: Free lists 400 minutes of storage per team, limited summaries and 20 AI credits. The Free card says unlimited transcription with an asterisk while the comparison says limited, so the actual free transcription conditions need confirmation. Annual-billing prices list Pro $10/seat/month, Business $19 and Enterprise $39, with Enterprise annual only. Pro lists 8,000 storage minutes per seat; higher plans advertise unlimited storage. AI credits and API limits remain separate, and individual recording duration is capped by plan.
sections.zh: Free 列每团队 400 分钟存储、有限摘要及 20 AI credits。Free 卡写带星号的不限转录，对照表却写有限，因此免费转录条件需确认。年付价格为 Pro 每席位每月十美元、Business 19、Enterprise 39，Enterprise 仅年付。Pro 每席位 8,000 存储分钟，较高版宣传不限存储。AI credits、API 限额另算，单次录制时长仍按套餐设上限。

sections.title_en: Sharing and regulated-data use require exact terms
sections.title_zh: 分享及受监管数据需核对具体条款
sections.en: Start with calendar/autojoin settings and a named owner of recordings, then test recap sharing and deletion. The homepage conditions healthcare/education agreements on Enterprise with Private Storage, so do not infer such eligibility from a general security logo. Fireflies is relevant to repeatable conversation records, not guaranteed transcription accuracy or approved decisions. Source licensing, data location, retention and recovery behavior were not independently verified.
sections.zh: 先配置日历自动加入和录制负责人，再测试摘要分享及删除。首页把医疗教育协议限定于带 Private Storage 的 Enterprise，不能从通用安全标识推定资格。它适合重复整理对话记录，但不保证转录准确或决策已批准。源码许可、数据位置、保留及恢复行为未独立核实。

sections.en: The official help guide applies 3,000 minutes per source per month to an individual external-upload source, including dashboard/API/Zapier uploads, storage imports and dialer calls. Teams multiply by users, capped at 150,000 minutes per source; overage is listed at $0.01/minute. Bot live meetings, the Google Meet extension and mobile recordings are exempt from this upload limit. Storage is the total retained meeting minutes, not a monthly allowance. The guide labels Free storage per user while the price card says per team, so that unit needs confirmation.
sections.zh: 官方帮助把外部上传个人额度列为每来源每月 3,000 分钟，包含界面、API、Zapier、存储导入及拨号通话。团队按用户倍增，每来源最多 150,000 分钟，超额每分钟 0.01 美元。机器人实时会议、Google Meet 扩展及移动录制不受该上传额度限制。存储指累计保留分钟，并非月额度。帮助页称 Free 按用户，价格卡称按团队，该单位仍需确认。
